edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: children followed into adolescence or adulthood
edges.mechanism: Earlier rebound signals a metabolic trajectory toward earlier and more persistent fat accumulation, making later obesity biologically and developmentally plausible.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2022 De Giuseppe cohort in Metabolites, which ties early adiposity rebound to adult obesity in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
